$description: Select V2 Component Contract. Select owns trigger, popup, option-item and tag composition; data source and selection reconciliation remain runtime-owned.

selection.single: one selected option; selecting an option closes the popup
selection.multiple: multiple selected options; selection can remain open for continued search

optionItem.single: an option item is a single selectable option, not a Checkbox component
optionItem.multiple: option item may contain a Checkbox plus label; the item owns the interaction state

pointerInteraction.meaning: default and hover describe the Select trigger

focus.meaning: focused describes trigger focus; popup item focus is an internal runtime focus

validation.meaning: error describes Select-level invalidity and has priority over hover/focus/disabled-like visuals

availability.meaning: disabled and loading lock trigger, popup and selection interaction

popup.meaning: open controls popup lifecycle; it is constrained by state and runtime availability

selection.meaning: single and multiple change selection semantics and internal structure, not the public Select family

compositionRules: Selection, Searchable, Appearance, State, Open and Size are Registry axes; data source and option availability are runtime data.
Select owns the trigger and popup composition; Option Item is a Select-owned structural Slot and is not a separate public component.
Single Option Item is a single option; Multiple Option Item may compose Checkbox visuals but does not become Checkbox semantically.
Multiple mode supports tags, popup bulk control and search-result selection; Single mode does not use tag collection semantics.
Popup search filters popup option results only and does not mutate the parent Select options or value.
The popup bulk control is a three-state selection control plus disabled state and acts on the declared search-result scope.
The popup bulk control remains frozen at the first row and is separated from option items by a divider.
Selecting a new Single option closes the popup; Multiple selection keeps the popup available for continued selection.
Clear changes the current value independently from popup open state and search text lifecycle.
Loading and disabled keep the popup closed and lock selection; error retains the Select structure while presenting invalidity.
Select reuses shared Checkbox visuals only where the Contract explicitly declares the internal composition.

recipeOwns: trigger, popup, option-item, tag, bulk-control, empty-state and indicator visual references
shared size, padding and spacing bindings
sparse appearance, state and open visual overrides
runtimeOwns: data source, option identity and availability
popup lifecycle, search query and keyboard navigation
tag overflow layout and search trigger activation
bulk selection scope and backend validation
contractDoesNotOwn: option data, selected values or search text
